query: How do I reset my password?
reference_answer: Go to the login page, click 'Forgot password?', enter your email, and use the reset link sent to you, which is valid for 30 minutes.

query: I didn't get the password reset email, what should I do?
reference_answer: Check your spam folder since reset emails come from no-reply@example.com; if you no longer have access to that email, contact support with a government-issued ID to verify your identity.

query: How do I get a refund?
reference_answer: Open a support ticket with your order ID and reason; annual plans are refundable within 14 days, monthly plans within 7 days, and refunds are processed within 5-10 business days.

query: What happens if my card payment fails?
reference_answer: The payment is retried three times over five days, with an email notification before each retry, before the account is downgraded to the free tier.

query: What is the API rate limit?
reference_answer: The free tier allows 100 requests per minute per API key, and paid plans allow 1,000 requests per minute; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

query: If I create more API keys, will I get a higher rate limit?
reference_answer: No, rate limits are tracked per account rather than per key, so all keys on an account share the same quota.

query: How do I delete my account?
reference_answer: Go to Account > Settings > Delete Account, re-enter your password, and confirm; deletion has a 30-day grace period before data is permanently erased.

query: If I delete my account, will I get a refund for the current billing period?
reference_answer: Deleting the account cancels future billing but does not refund the current billing period unless it falls within the refund window.

query: How do I set up two-factor authentication?
reference_answer: Enable it under Account > Security using a TOTP authenticator app; SMS-based 2FA is not supported, and you'll get 10 single-use backup codes.

query: I lost my authenticator app and my backup codes, what do I do?
reference_answer: Account recovery requires manual identity verification through support, which can take up to 3 business days.

query: After I change my password, will I stay logged in on my phone?
reference_answer: No. Setting a new password signs you out of all other active sessions, so you'll need to log back in on your other devices.

query: Where can I see when I'll be charged next?
reference_answer: Under Account > Billing. Subscriptions renew automatically on the same day each billing cycle using the payment method on file.

query: If I switch from monthly to annual billing halfway through the month, do I get charged a prorated amount?
reference_answer: No. Switching between monthly and annual billing takes effect at the start of the next cycle; mid-cycle plan changes are not prorated.

query: How long does it take for a refund to show up?
reference_answer: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days, back to the original payment method.

query: How many requests per minute can I make to the bulk export endpoints?
reference_answer: Bulk export endpoints have a separate, lower limit of 10 requests per minute because of their higher processing cost.

query: I keep getting 429 errors. How should my client handle them?
reference_answer: A 429 means the rate limit was exceeded. Wait the number of seconds given in the Retry-After header before retrying, and use exponential backoff with jitter rather than retrying immediately.

query: Can I get my API rate limit raised?
reference_answer: Contact support with your expected request volume if you have a legitimate need for a higher limit. Creating more API keys won't help because limits are shared across the account.

query: What data gets erased when my account is deleted?
reference_answer: After the 30-day grace period, all account data, including tickets, uploaded files, and API keys, is permanently erased and cannot be recovered.

query: I'm a member of a team account but not the owner. Can I delete the organization account?
reference_answer: No. Team/organization accounts can only be deleted by the account owner; other members must be removed or transferred first.

query: Which authenticator apps can I use for 2FA?
reference_answer: Any TOTP-compatible authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Authy.

query: I've used up most of my backup codes. Can I get new ones?
reference_answer: Yes. You can regenerate a fresh set of backup codes at any time from the Security page; each code can only be used once.

query: How do I turn off two-factor authentication?
reference_answer: Disabling 2FA requires entering a current code from your authenticator app or a backup code, and it can't be turned off from a session that hasn't completed 2FA.

query: I bought a monthly plan 5 days ago. Can I still get a refund?
reference_answer: Yes. Monthly plans are refundable within 7 days, so 5 days is inside the window. Open a support ticket with the order ID and reason; refunds take 5-10 business days.

query: I purchased an annual plan 3 weeks ago. Can I get a full refund?
reference_answer: No. Annual plans are refundable only within 14 days of purchase, and 3 weeks is outside that window. The agent must not promise a refund.

query: I deleted my account by accident yesterday. Can I get it back?
reference_answer: Yes. Deleted accounts enter a 30-day grace period; logging back in during that period cancels the deletion.

query: I deleted my account 40 days ago. Can support restore my data?
reference_answer: No. After the 30-day grace period all account data is permanently erased and cannot be recovered, so data from an account deleted 40 days ago is gone.

query: I got a new phone and lost my authenticator app, but I still have my backup codes. How do I get in?
reference_answer: Sign in with one of the backup codes (each works only once). Backup codes are the way back in when you lose access to your authenticator app; no support recovery is needed.

query: How do I set up SMS two-factor authentication?
reference_answer: SMS-based 2FA is not supported. 2FA uses a TOTP authenticator app, enabled under Account > Security.

query: Your annual plans have a 30-day money-back guarantee, right?

query: Once I click Delete Account my data is erased immediately, right?

query: If my card gets declined, will my account be downgraded right away?
reference_answer: No. A failed payment is retried three times over five days, with an email before each retry; the account is only downgraded to the free tier if those retries fail.

query: The password reset link is valid for 24 hours, so I can use it tomorrow, right?

query: The rate limit resets at the top of every minute, so I can burst all my requests right after it resets?
reference_answer: No. Limits use a sliding window, not a fixed per-minute bucket, so bursting after a minute boundary doesn't get extra requests.

query: I bought an annual plan 10 days ago and now want to delete my account entirely. Will I get my money back?
reference_answer: Deleting the account cancels future billing but doesn't by itself refund the current period unless it's within the refund window. Annual plans are refundable within 14 days, so at 10 days they're eligible: open a support ticket with the order ID and reason.

query: I lost my phone with my authenticator app, never saved my backup codes, and I no longer have access to my account email either. How do I get back in?
